categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in residential and commercial building development, real estate sales, and leasing. It focuses on developing high-quality residential buildings, townhouses, apartments, and commercial office buildings mainly for the domestic market in Taiwan's major metropolitan areas.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs professional architectural planning and design by renowned domestic architects, combined with strict construction quality control and project management. It uses tailored construction methods suited to different project types, emphasizing safety, cost control, and timely completion to ensure high-quality building products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are domestic individuals and corporations purchasing residential and commercial properties. The main markets are urban areas in Taiwan, especially Taipei City, New Taipei City, Taoyuan City, Taichung City, Tainan City, and Kaohsiung City.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Taiwan's six major metropolitan areas (Taipei, New Taipei, Taoyuan, Taichung, Tainan, and Kaohsiung). The company develops and sells properties primarily within these urban regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the real estate supply chain, handling land acquisition, development, construction management, sales, and after-sales services. It outsources construction work to professional contractors but manages project planning and sales directly.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include selecting prime land near transportation hubs and quality living environments, focusing on customer- and market-oriented product planning to enhance added value. The company emphasizes brand building, product differentiation through design and quality, and sustainable growth. R&D focuses on market analysis, architectural design innovation, and construction management improvements.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of developed residential and commercial properties, including pre-sale and completed units. Additional income comes from property leasing and other minor sources.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a fragmented real estate market with many players and relatively low individual market shares. It differentiates itself through high-quality design, construction, and brand reputation, targeting specific market segments with premium residential and commercial projects.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported revenues of approximately NT$22.1 billion and a net profit of about NT$314.8 million, showing significant growth compared to the previous year. Total assets were around NT$17.1 billion with a stable equity base. The company has demonstrated improved profitability and financial stability after recovering from prior losses.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes '5V' values: prime location, aesthetic design, collectibility, practicality, and safety to create high-quality, desirable properties. It leverages professional architectural design, strict construction quality control, and customer-oriented service to build a strong brand and competitive edge in the market.
